description: Long-form writing craft, two passes. stark-story-edit rewrites a draft post for hook, arc, humor, and endings while keeping every fact frozen - no invented details, no derived numbers - and hands the author a diff plus the story at every size (title, summary, TL;DR, title variants). stark-blog-sharpen is the adversarial cut-only pass - kill padding until the post earns every word, then scrub the AI tells so it reads like a person.
name: stark-write
